pages.privacy_scope_body: Covers all data collected via messmax.net, our backend API (messmax.net/api/*), and the MessMax mobile app (Android/iOS, package com.messmax.net.app). It does not cover pages or ads hosted on third-party sites you reach by following links inside our app/site.
pages.privacy_contact_dpo_body: Controller: MessMax (Bangladesh). Data queries and requests: Contact page or email contact@messmax.net. We aim to respond within 7 business days.
pages.privacy_account_body: Name, email address, password (bcrypt hashed — never stored in plain text), optional avatar image, and chosen account type (hostel owner / individual). When you sign in with Google, we store the verified email and display name returned by Google and the hashed internal ID — never your Google password.
pages.privacy_mess_title: b) Mess content you create or join
pages.privacy_mess_body: Mess names/slugs, member lists (display name, email, role), monthly sheets (meals per day per member, bazar expenses per day, guest meals, deposits, extras), bazar duty schedules, and seat ads (location string, phone/WhatsApp contacts you publish, amenity list, pricing). This is the core dataset you own; we host it for you.
pages.privacy_auto_body: Device/app version, X-API-Key header value, sanitized FCM tokens, app activity logs, IP-derived approximate geo (city/district), and aggregate metrics (page views, API calls). Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) is used to deliver push notifications; Google may process token/device data on our behalf per Google’s Privacy Policy.
pages.privacy_cookies_body: Session cookie: one first-party httpOnly cookie for login (laravel_session). CSRF token cookie. Language preference (lang). LocalStorage (mobile): auth tokens and push tokens via flutter_secure_storage — no third-party tracking cookies are set by MessMax.
pages.privacy_pub_data_title: e) Data you choose to make public
pages.privacy_pub_data_body: When you publish a seat ad, fields such as seats_available, rent_per_seat, area/city, amenities, description, and contact phone/WhatsApp become visible to anyone browsing /ads or calling /api/home. Use “Hide exact address” in the ad form to suppress street-level location from visitors.
pages.privacy_use_body:
• Operate, personalize, and troubleshoot the mess management service.
  • Authenticate you, enforce roles (owner/manager/member), calculate meal rates Rate = SUM(Bazar)/SUM(Meals) and per-member bills.
  • Send transactional email (invite, OTP, bazar/announcement, request decisions) via the SMTP host an admin configures — or log driver in development.
  • Deliver push notifications via FCM for meal/bazar/invite/manager events and marketing broadcasts opted into.
  • Provide public translation and ad listings to unauthenticated clients (home/seat feed).
  • Enforce rate limits and the X-API-Key client gate to block scraping/abuse, detect fraud, and secure the platform.
pages.privacy_legal_basis_body: Where GDPR applies: Contract performance (providing your chosen mess service), legitimate interest (security, analytics, product improvement), consent (marketing push/showcasing an ad publicly), and legal obligation (compliance, fraud prevention). You may withdraw consent at any time (e.g., delete an ad, uninstall/disable push) without affecting prior lawful processing.
pages.privacy_share_title: 4. With whom and where we share data
pages.privacy_share_body:
• Within your mess only: meals, deposits, and bazar details are visible to members of that mess. Nothing outside the mess sees that private sheet.
  • Public feed: published seat ads and their subset of metadata (above) are globally readable.
  • Subprocessors: our hosting provider (Heroku, eu region) stores and serves the database/filesystem; Google (Firebase FCM & Google Sign-In — 1069180546995-u7cik408g6uj08rctf798be1133n5fib.apps.googleusercontent.com); the SMTP provider selected in /hq-secure-k7p/smtp sends emails; Cloudflare passes encrypted traffic. Each provider processes data per its own published policy.
  • Transfers: data may transit outside your locality (e.g., EU host). We rely on the provider’s Standard Contractual Clauses and compatible safeguards for such transfers.
  • Never: we do not sell your data, run data-broker syncs, or serve third-party ad trackers inside our product.
pages.privacy_retention_body: We keep your data while your account/mess exists and for 90 days after deletion to handle disputes/restores, then purge or anonymize. Logs are rotated within 90 days. Marketing push records are retained per broadcast until deleted in /hq-secure-k7p/notifications. OTP codes (password_reset_otps) expire 10 minutes after generation and are deleted on reuse/reset.
pages.privacy_children_body: MessMax is not directed to children under 13. We knowingly collect no data from them. If you believe a minor provided data, contact us and we will remove it promptly.
pages.privacy_security_body: Deployed over HTTPS (forceScheme). Passwords are bcrypt-hashed; audit tokens are hashed. Public APIs require X-API-Key (key mm_sec_live_···) plus scoped rate limits (api-public / api-auth / api-bulk and web 60s OTP cooldown). File uploads are bound by mime/size checks; database activity is revokable per-role.
pages.privacy_your_rights_body:
• Access / export: request a copy of your account & member data via Contact.
  • Correction / deletion: edit your profile or delete your account in Dashboard → My Account or ask an admin in /hq-secure-k7p/users — deletions cascade to linked member entries per our sync.
  • Objection / restriction: disable push, archive a seat ad, or set a mess to inactive.
  • Withdraw consent: clear consent-gated data (e.g., a public ad).
We respond within 30 days where feasible. Repeated deletion for the same email may be rate-limited to prevent abuse.
pages.privacy_intl_notice_body: Our infrastructure and our notarized data transfers may locate your data outside your country (e.g., Dhaka user data may be stored on an EU host or delivered via a global CDN). By using MessMax, you consent to such transfer subject to this policy and applicable law.
pages.privacy_changes_body: We may update this page when features or laws change. Continued use after a posted update means you accept the revised policy. Material changes will be noted here with a new “Last updated” date.
pages.privacy_grievance_body: Questions about data handling? Visit Contact — we write back.
pages.terms_scope_body:
• You must be at least 13 years old and capable of entering a binding contract. A mess may include older/younger members at the manager’s discretion.
  • One account per verified email. Keep your password and Google authorization private. You are responsible for all actions under your credentials and Google Sign-In session (OAuth client 1069180546995-…).
  • Provide accurate name/email; notify us promptly of unauthorized access so we can reset or block the credential.
  • We may suspend or terminate accounts that abuse rate limits, scrape with bots, or circumvent the X-API-Key gate or OTP cooldowns.
pages.terms_services_body:
MessMax is a meal counter, bazar/meal-request ledger, and seat marketplace — not a financial custodian.

  • Sheet engine: Counts daily meals (breakfast/lunch/dinner), applies approved ON/OFF requests, tallies bazar totals, computes Meal Rate = Σ Bazar / Σ Meals, and derives Spend = Rate × meals + Extra/N, Given, and REST identical to the legacy MAY MEAL COUNTER.xlsx logic.
  • Monthly manager rotation: one owner/manager per active month; ownership can be transferred in-mess.
  • Ads marketplace: publish seat availability (incl. contact phone/WhatsApp); public visitors and API clients can browse, search, and contact you directly — we are a notice board, not a party to any tenancy.
  • Notifications & email: invites, OTP, bazar duty, announcements, and marketing pushes (via FCM and SMTP) are best-effort. The admin configures which SMTP and which FCM credential (storage/app/private/firebase/firebase-admin.json and app_settings.firebase_admin_json) is live.
  • Pricing: the core platform is currently free. If paid plans are introduced, terms, pricing, and billing cadence will be posted at that time and require renewed consent.
pages.terms_user_duties_body:
• Input meals, bazaar amounts, guest meals, deposits, and extras accurately; only a manager can approve/cancel a member’s meal-OFF or guest request.
  • Do not publish false, illegal, harassing, hateful, or infringing seat ads. You are solely responsible for your ad copy, pricing, and tenant interactions.
  • Do not attempt to scrape at scale, brute-force login/OTP, overload SMTP/FCM, or reverse-engineer the X-API-Key or Firebase app to impersonate a privileged client.
pages.terms_agent_body: Mess balances, deposits, and REST(TK) shown on the sheet are purely informational. No funds transit through MessMax; deposit tracking mirrors cash exchanged offline between members. We never hold, escrow, or settle real money for you.
pages.terms_ip_body:
• You retain all rights to mess names, member notes, and ad copy/photos — and grant MessMax a revocable, non-exclusive license to host and display them as needed to operate the service (including to public visitors for published ads).
  • MessMax’s branding, UI, and codebase are ours. You may not copy or remove our notices.
pages.terms_third_body: Seat inquiries may originate from outside our platform (Google searches, Facebook links, other classifieds). We cannot verify external parties, so you must independently verify any guest/tenant/landlord before granting them access or handing over keys or funds.
pages.terms_termination_body:
• You may delete your account or archive your mess at any time — member rows linked by email are synced/removed accordingly.
  • We may warn, rate-limit, or suspend an account, mess, or seat ad that breaches these Terms, abuses services, or receives validated takedown complaints. Admin deletions in /hq-secure-k7p/users and /hq-secure-k7p/messes are final.
  • Provisions that by nature survive (IP, disclaimers, limitations, this section) do so after termination.
pages.terms_disclaimer_body:
The service is provided “as is” and “as available.”

  • We do not warrant uninterrupted availability, even though the sheet is expected to auto-save and stay online.
  • Calculation accuracy is verified against the public formula, but you remain responsible for reconciling cash offline. Keep your own screenshots/exports.
  • Public seat listings are member-published; we do not guarantee a posting’s truthfulness or the suitability of any counterparty.
pages.terms_liability_body:
To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, in no event shall MessMax, its operators, or collaborators be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages — including loss of profit, data loss/corruption, or tenant disputes. Our aggregate liability for any claim arising out of your use, even if advised of the possibility of such damages, shall not exceed BDT 5,000 or the fees you paid in the prior 3 months (whichever is greater).

Keep your own backups. Periodically export or screenshot your sheet.
